Mechanically serialize recorded step and smallest advice through occurrence-preserving CQ normalization; no printer selects an order, step or intersection site.
The phases timing variant includes candidate materialization before separately clocked admission; none streams candidates. Materialization is part of the timing variant, not a printer optimization.

Layouts record grouped-map entry/default-reset, all-column key-set insert/contains/default-reset, or bulk extend/push/membership/clear maintenance equal to their token's declared protocol, independently of provider spelling; Round preserves the protocol and printers consume it.

Check reversible scan annotations, host facts and optional per_task witnesses; restore only the permitted registered standard empty-argument Pull-to-Push rule terminal substitution before exact erasure equality, preserving registry and admission ownership.

Every IDB canonical layout becomes a sharded or run layout (bulk); by default only canonical layouts change, and optionally every nonempty-key IDB full/delta `hash_map` or `hash_set` layout becomes a `sharded_layout` (same hasher) or `run_layout` (from the Fx hasher) token instance spelled from its recorded schema; partition only appends its token declarations; erase token, hasher and protocol together, preserving unit-key/EDB layouts, other Storage records and CQ queues; Round admits set/grouped-map tokens without admission strategy and partition's bulk tokens on keyed IDB layouts.

Direct checks establish admission shard ownership, total injective native-layout owners and publication barriers without invoking the producer; preserve independently checked base admission owners and per-hole context facts.

Subtract the committed canonical layout from every candidate chunk, then build the round's NEW canonical version by the canonical token's declared admission (`sharded_hash`: per-shard check-committed and insert into NEW with the committed hasher, admitted rows concatenated; `sorted_subtract`: sort/dedup) so each fresh tuple is admitted once; task-local deduplication uses the token's declared task hasher.
Each full or delta native layout has one exclusive task; full publication joins before delta replacement and all delta rebuilds join before evaluation.

Interpret each member's recorded publication operations in exact order in both early and phase-barrier paths; parallelize only distinct layout owners within one operation and join before its successor, never sorting by owner.
Change only named non-host stream results from pipe to let; erasure and the exhaustive bag are preserved.
A let side supplies merge order unless it is a canon result with one unkeyed reader, stored only in its by-value canonical index.
Check named results, total segments, input provenance and lookup headings.
Sequence rewrites preserve Structures except for checked catalog retention; support equality cannot authorize a Physical join reorder.
A probe is a flatten of per-row lookups; ordinary row stores need exact buckets, segmented flatten and distributed or collective reads need contiguous ranges; semi/anti need membership.
An ordered read of a host result is typed by the fallback recorded for its merge reader, not another reader's.

Each checked Sequence lookup records its own required capability by provider, result reader and key; it uses only that reader's native record on the same key. Sequence admits exact or membership reads covering that lookup's requirement, with no provider or codec premise. Grading promotes the recorded per-lookup requirement when it adds Range obligations and rechecks only checked lookups; unsupported or weaker native reads are rejected before printing.
Positive contiguous tiles cover their domain; folds use the closed commutative monoid grammar.
A positive machine-fixed pool width redistributes an ancestor store into a key-disjoint bag cover, retaining empty parts; one part is the identity cover at the same pool.
Complete valuations determine routing keys, so per-part complete-valuation canon replaces the global canonical boundary.
Nonempty group keys determine routing keys; canonical complete valuations and keyed folds stay inside each part.
Exact point lookup keys determine routing keys; building per-part providers and routing identically preserves lookup buckets.
Check nested positions and derive symbolic exclusive-scan lengths for flatten.
Global support requires a valid complete-valuation boundary; carry the recorded canonical reference (CanonSource) and codec obligations; providers remain trait obligations.
The default canonical rows provider dedup::Sort defers to the first demand, then collects the whole stream, compares opaque fields by Rust Ord, sort_unstable and adjacent-unique; Tasks uses par_sort.
A canon = host reference consumes immutable load-verified prefix runs and sorts/uniques complete rows within each run; prefix order never establishes uniqueness.
Stable least-significant-lane radix sorting and complete-row equality instantiate BE-Canon for arbitrary-width packed keys.

A checked binding marks an input as packed device runs; scans visit every run, prefix lookups take one contiguous word range per run expanded block-uniformly, and membership is the disjunction over runs.

A raw-candidate terminal dispatch records its arena encoding (head columns in order at their recorded carriers) in publication storage; the arena translation prints that record into a caller-owned device buffer with its length, sized by the recorded output protocol, never truncated, and rejects terminals without it; the result is a candidate bag for admission.
With metadata and BE-Abort checked before publication and all uses ordered on the producing stream, an arena batch is published without a terminal fence; timing events are opt-in.

The recorded reserve_previous arena protocol starts from the last validated count as capacity, counts all candidates, writes in bounds, reruns on shortfall against the same snapshot and publishes only a validated prefix, equal to the count protocol batch.

Query-closed where operands record consuming definitions and use the recorded equality/order-preserving codec on the host; every closed subexpression, literals included, is extracted once into realization records and printed from them; enabled nonempty dispatches guard cached captures. Rust payloads are not split or dictionary-rewritten. Contract 7 conformance unverified.
Every logical symbol type has one structurally checked codec identity across declared native layouts; conflicting declarations are rejected before capture translation.

Declared token facts select range/runs/columns/radix ABI, contiguous ranges and resident-column bounds; native Host inputs record ordered logical/storage schemas and optional codecs, with no Rust type recognition.

GPU binding records provider identity/ABI, exact payload demands, complete native permutations, complete download/upload adapters and dense-directory policy before printing; checks reject stale or missing facts.

Every instance of a radix-ABI token records authored advice (word and offset carriers, ratio >= 2, radix_bits <= 32, merge tile >= 1) and no other instance may; the radix token is registered after the existing catalog tokens, so unadvised selection is unchanged.

GPU binding records a radix instance's key and value-lane carriers from recorded column types (dictionary codes as u32), the advice's W/O/params and the read form of every lookup prefix and PH-Smallest side it serves; the checker compares each against its source.

Distinct counts the keys of an encoded interval over the union of all runs (each key once, in its oldest run; never a sum of per-run counts) and distinct_at enumerates exactly those keys; runtime law tests against a candidate-set oracle.

A bound leading key prefix is encoded once into an inclusive whole-word interval (low/high suffix fill, no high+1); out-of-domain values match nothing; per-run item intervals equal the CPU RadixRun groups.

A radix layout built from resident source columns packs key fields and fills one value lane per field (through a recorded selection when present) and publishes them by the ordinary grouped build; its only host synchronization is the group count.

A PH-Smallest probe is realized only when every side is a two-level radix layout with a recorded Candidates read: exact union counts per side, the first minimum side enumerates, others test membership; otherwise the target rejects it, never a First probe. The checker validates column, sides, count and tie records.
GPU binding records the keyed accumulator provider in Structures and terminal grouping invokes that recorded provider; keyless folds have no keyed accumulator table.

GPU refinement records flat carrier stride or complete FOR fields with immutable bounds provenance, canonical-provider granularity, host-union staging and, exactly for a raw-candidate terminal dispatch, the arena encoding; the independent checker validates stated source invariants rather than repeating storage selection. Flat publication writes only recorded resident columns; deferred payloads are read on expansion, never from parent slots; unmapped live row accesses fail compilation.

After publication storage the target records sources, per-definition steps, host transfers, provider descriptor bounds, auxiliary element geometry and captures; an independent checker validates each record against its checked source (union arms, transfer coverage, provider origins, captures, supported geometry) without rerunning selection; a provider has one owner preceding every reader: a nonterminal publication builds it unless an earlier definition looks it up, in which case the source builds it and the publication does not; a selection failure is recorded and raised only when that candidate is printed.

Each device source records resident, run or uploaded origin, scan/positions/provider access and setup/build phase; an interval records every contiguous selection bound on one column, including equality, and the checker verifies the bounds as a set against the source chain's constraints; runs take no interval.
Host evaluations record bound completed publications and complete-row transfers of publications and resident inputs, each downloaded once per invocation.
Provider descriptors print recorded bounds: renamed resident inputs or upload metadata merged in order, or the Scalar carrier; only recorded keys over packed runs are measured with one readback.
The terminal group records its Physical group, canonical/stored/source/host input with any upload, its store aliases, and segmented or grid-partials completion; printing reroutes nothing.

A keyless group fuses argument evaluation into typed per-block partials with extremum presence over an occupancy grid at recorded block geometry, then one stream-ordered combine block per aggregate at recorded combine geometry; empty input keeps the identity row and checked overflow sets the sticky failure.

Codec injectivity and monotonicity remain runtime trait premises recorded in Sequence Analysis.obligations; each obligation records its exact codec (the declared Structures input codec of the column's logical type, or identity) and only that catalog codec token discharges it.
Check exhaustive length or positive-bound uniform worker guards and construction-equal alternatives; join their size types.
Check complete grades, lexical order and reads inside ancestor store extents; stores enclose explicitly named host/descendant producers for publication in either direction.
A fold, scan or flatten at a level with members is admissible only at a collaborative level with whole participation; at a leaf level it is a sequential loop.
Reject exchange across separated siblings without an ancestor store.
Derive Len once; grading consumes checked store facts, and completed publications provide runtime input lengths.

Derive borrow, alias, owned-row or key-part publication once before reheading; routed providers are the recorded inner instances of routed tokens (STR-Routed), with stored outer routing keys validated upstream.
Record stable producer identities through term ancestry and Ref; task joins consume identities, not generated tokens.
Record task-driver and selected-choice carrier publications; account their symbolic retained-row traffic.

Derive maximal total dispatch segments, outer domains and publications; host-produced downward transfers are uploads, not query dispatches. Placement publishes independent union arms beneath unary consumers, including canon, before host concatenation.

Verbatim device Rust reads only provider-recorded identity columns plus closed captures; encoded or unknown reads execute at host. Encoded comparisons use where and host codec captures, never type-name recognition. Contract 7 conformance unverified.

Binding records identity and encoded column facts from provider/codec declarations, never host type spelling, and each column's device carrier once (a declared codec's u32 code, else the logical type), checked against every row and capture binder that types it; unknown columns do not justify device Rust. Contract 7 conformance unverified.
Every dispatch has a path to host; runtime flag propagation remains a recorded failure obligation.

Consume Structures carried-column demand and derive payload demands, including each expansion's carried parent columns, from recorded publication refinement; ordinary range publication expands in place. Grading checks target layout against bounded producer-level capacity, and the printer carries exactly the recorded parents.
Interpret checked Sequence with shared indexed task dispatch, ordered task-local buffer publication, monoidal reductions and local then global canonicalization.
Materialize selected flatten definitions with exclusive-scan lengths and unchanged support; factor a named producer for separately graded publication.
Wrap a definition in positive contiguous tiles; unknown-length stores require capacity.
Select earlier independently checked equal-support definitions under exhaustive length or worker guards.
Count, reserve, reserve_previous and bounded set final output without changing support; bounded requires capacity.
Record roots spread after every definition without changing the construction or support.
Add or update placements on one named machine without changing construction; machine validation is deferred.
Return a replayable trace of checked Sequence rewrites and a machine-checked graded program.
Preserve authored decisions, fill only missing decomposition and validate recorded catalog obligations.
Enumerate candidates and catalog tokens in fixed order and break remaining ties by that order.

A target catalog declares provider tokens and keys its entries by token id (and inner token); a program declaration of a token the catalog declares must equal it, and admission reads the entry's levels and the declared facts. Codec obligations are admitted only by the token of their recorded codec; canon obligations only through their recorded rows or answer-index token at the level grading recorded; a missing token or level is unmet.

Stable-partition catalog entries by the recorded token, retain unsupported host reads through checked Physical retention, and select the first entry whose declared facts satisfy read and live support obligations with nonempty levels; a recorded token keeps its spelling, a new one takes the entry's; replace provider/support together and distinguish construction from consumption.
Only an explicit resident token admits an unretained native host handle at descendant read levels; the same token, declared read capability and levels remain mandatory.
A Distinct provider's build from any row stream yields exactly its distinct complete rows and its scan reads each stored row once; only such providers type a canonical rows record.

Compare checked execution costs using Analysis.partial_groups for Group modes; preserve work, inversion, span, retained traffic, store and dispatch tie ordering, charging owned publications while checked borrow/alias publication is free.

Default one-part lowering preserves Physical retention, except that a canon let whose rows record moves by value (STR-RowsByValue) lowers without a Store like a canon pipe, and records explicit lookup, membership, union and final count-store terms.
Host iterator interpretation with recorded capabilities and carrier publications; ordinary choices erase to Else, worker-guarded choices evaluate first-match guards.

Interpret checked GPU dispatches with recorded tiles, strips, collaborative scans, provider ABI, grouping, publication storage, key codec and realization records; reject unsupported provider construction, witnesses, staging and join filters rather than substituting implementations.
A host_set fact means the full rows of R form a set; check that each fact names one used host.
Record that the invoking consumer owns the returned set boundary and is support-invariant.
The returned boundary is admissible by inferred uniqueness, an explicit return canon, or a consumer canonical fact.
A certified host_set fact is established by the executing program (IF-HostSet); discharged facts emit no local certificate.
Record facts supplied by the invoking compiler's argument packet; its checker must prove them.
Require an explicit context envelope exactly equal to restricted source facts; argument packets do not authorize factful reentry, and only lower/select introduce facts.
Record estimates and explicit author key premises; key-dependent rewrites are conditional on their truth.

Sequence Analysis records counts and keys through Unit, Rename, filters, scalar Bind, Project, Group (one row for global identity), Semi/Anti and keyed Probe/Merge; checker validates local recorded premises, allowing weakened bounds and either justified join side.

Below-one-tile GPU dispatch roots retain the first expansion reaching retain_prefix_rows when another follows; stop at unknown bounds. Replay consumes Analysis prefix_bounds and explicit width/threshold, checking root, bound, threshold, first-known and following-expansion premises without rerunning advice.
After a retained prefix, segment each expansion whose lookup covers no recorded provider key at width times items.
Fold the same set of complete named valuations for every head aggregate, with nonaggregate variables as keys.

Require canonical complete valuations and keyed segment folds, including one empty global identity group; the GPU instance uses radix owner offsets, typed monoids, validity columns and checked publication.

Globally unique contiguous parts fold keyed finite maps and merge at host into flat present-key rows; unkeyed partial folds produce a singleton including empty identity. Key-routed keyed groups retain independent covers.

Asserted physical keys transfer through renames, filters, scalar binds and joins; Analysis records canon-free valuation uniqueness only for the group's rewrite target at slot zero. Planner applies canon removal only from this fact and propagates rewrite errors.
Compile only the explicit input target and propagate rejection without retry or clearing advice.
Check explicit stage/input/publication records, schema interfaces, domain identity and projection bounds without recovering semantics from embedded Rust.
Record semantic nullable columns and explicit placement before generation; reject unsupported nullable device publication.

A resident grouped answer records slots and key bounds sources; independently check each slot against its head argument and each input bound against its key-binding positive atom field and recorded input placement. Missing input placements are errors; aggregates and unbound keys take full bounds; the wrapper only prints the record.
Resolve workload catalog labels to serializable recipe inputs before compilation and execute only checked explicit advice.
Share registered endpoint identities across macro and programmatic rewrites; parse opaque invocation arguments without a second grammar.

Record GPU execution before BE-Resource, including initial capacity, stripe-batch reservation and per-level strips with resolved defaults and fold scopes; independently check offset/synchronization obligations, positive tile sizes and the legality of partition, sharing and metadata records without rerunning their selection; resource accounting and emission consume one deferred-range publication fact, and host-reference traversal stops at completed publications.
Query device SM count and actual kernel resident blocks at prepare time; cap grid by domain tile count.

Under roots spread a fold-free dispatch records Spread(max_rows) with any positive bound, its declared distributed tile when present; the launch sizes root tiles from the resident block count, at most max_rows; folds and other roots keep the declared partition.

Sharing is optional; a recorded share names a spread single-chain dispatch with one source tile that expands, and a positive u32 tile cap; it shares the first expansion: per-tile cursors, owner announcements, helper replays; each batch is claimed exactly once.

Fresh metadata is always sound; resident metadata is legal only for a reserve_previous arena terminal with a local fold: zero arena words on entry, the last finished block publishes count/failure and re-zeroes the used words; attempts neither allocate nor clear metadata.
Device-wide exclusive scan completes deferred range offsets; adjacent-prefix wrapping and existing failures reject publication before consumers.
Whole-input folds write block partials and publish only after a recorded stream-ordered combine; empty input retains the identity.

Opt-in preclosing child observations preserve checked Sequence execution; block leaders sum children, failed capacity attempts are discarded, and Datalog attributes unique fresh output against pre-round state.

Distinct over batches is the incremental anti-join against the output relation; any batch partition yields the same set. CQ realizes the one-batch instance as its canonical index build (STR-Canon, PL-Distinct); row-granularity admission is unimplemented.
Anti-join distributes over bag union of producers.
Distinct commutes with anti-join.
Partial distinct of parts preserves the distinct of the union (per-task distinct).

CPU Datalog: an in_plan rule hole binds computed head terms and appends the ordinary negation !C(x̄) over the head's committed canonical layout (canonical column order); pinned by known(at(level k)) advice. GPU Datalog records admit only (follow-up).

Advice known(admit) or known(at(level k)) (level >= binding level) decides; otherwise a hole whose queue records a planning invocation is in plan iff a read after the written head-binding level is recorded multiply (DL-Fanout), else admit; device storage admits only. Only explicit advice pins a numeric level; automatic negations follow CQ readiness after reordered head bindings. Correspondence checks admission against advice and the record, then erases exactly the synthetic suffix.

Each positive read of a variant, in variant order, is multiply iff it introduces a variable (wildcards are enumerated witnesses) and binds no recorded key of its relation; otherwise filter. Recorded on RuleHole.fanout and checked by fork correspondence.
Datalog source evidence names its provenance; each key names a declared relation and distinct declared columns; keys of one relation are distinct. No denotation.
CPU TPC-H default and par record dbgen SF1 counts and TPC-H primary keys for canonical base relations as plan(evidence ...); other configurations and queries without base relations unchanged.

Independently check each producer discharges the committed anti-join exactly once: in_plan holes end with the single committed negation, admit holes have none; all remain admission-owned (residual δ) and in_plan holes record the committed head read in the schedule.
Reads between maintenance steps observe one represented relation; immutable runs and Rust borrows preserve cursor snapshots.

RadixRun's inherent maintenance merge is a multiset union (no disjointness premise): append the grouped delta, stably merge adjacent runs by merge-path while the geometric item-count ratio is violated; direct reads include all unmerged runs.
One total order embedding covers stored and absent keys for dense, rank and radix representations; sealed codec policies delegate to that embedding.
Plain and Bytes block vector decodes concatenate to exactly the ordered input occurrences; Bytes selects constant, u8 or u16 residuals when narrower than the native ordinal, otherwise plain.
Optional min/max encloses the same block whose ordinals are collected in one input pass and emitted as payload; no decoded-column summary pass.
Point, open/closed window and membership predicates on residual codes are equivalent to logical ordinal predicates including absent constants and endpoint overflow.

Columnar source loading preserves ordered occurrences without an intermediate tuple vector; payload and optional extrema share the input pass, with finalized string-code remapping fused into encoding.
Explicit vector or tuple-vector layouts preserve occurrence positions and column lengths; group merges copy slices without reconstructing rows.

An item layout belongs to a one-level non-membership payload build of a token declaring an items slot, and every such build records one; items columns requires a payload of at least two fields (filtered schema, else carried columns, without the key). The instance spelling ends before the slot; the checked analysis prints the declared rows/columns spelling there.
A token declaring a choice slot is spelled up to that argument; a host entry prints the declared lazy argument iff its served Physical reader records lazy, other entries print eager.

radix_runs records the radix_run token's default instance with items columns iff the payload has 2..=12 fields and some probe or merge on the index key carries a strict subset of it; otherwise items rows. The declared slot prints TupleColumns or Vec.

Packed canonical rows: span-relative OrderKey ordinals packed most significant column first with the row position into one sortable word; reading in word order and skipping equal keys equals the comparator build; spans over 128 bits or more than u32 rows use the comparator.
Authored advice retypes canonical rows records typed dedup::Sort to dedup::Packed; the premise that every column has an OrderKey is authored and checked by rustc; nothing else changes.
